defaults.about: Hearth Advisory plans tax, cash, and the decisions that sit between them. The relationship is meant to last longer than one filing season.
defaults.missionStatement: Advice aimed at the decade, not the week.
defaults.servicesSectionSubtitle: Individual filings, business strategy, and year-round advisory for people who think in decades.

services.title: Prep + refund advance
services.description: We finish the return, then push Holiday or Shield funds — often the same day, always the same week when the file is clean.

services.title: Referral drop
services.description: They mention your name. They file. You get paid. That is the whole program.

services.title: Business + audit armor
services.description: Schedule C, 1120, 1099 stacks. If the revenue authority writes, existing clients do not get a new invoice.

steps.title: Dump the docs

steps.title: We run the year

steps.title: Pick the product

steps.title: Get wired
steps.description: Approved files fund in 30 minutes to 48 hours. the revenue authority pays us back. You keep living.

faqs.question: Do I have to take the advance?
faqs.answer: No. File and wait if you want. We only size an advance after the return is done.

faqs.question: How fast is fast?
faqs.answer: Clean files: 30 minutes to 48 hours. Messy files take longer because we will not guess.

faqs.question: What do I bring?
faqs.answer: ID, TINs, employment income statements or pay stubs, dependent docs. We text the list when you book.

faqs.question: Holiday vs Shield?
faqs.answer: Holiday: no Flux fee, smaller. Shield: 27,500 ETB–412,500 ETB, bank fees shown before you tap yes.
